ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two operational amplifiers cascaded. The non-inverting terminal of the first-stage op-amp is connected to the input Vin, and the inverting-terminal node is connected to ground through the inductor L on one hand, and connected to the first-stage output through the feedback resistor R1 on the other hand; therefore the first stage is a non-inverting amplification structure with feedback impedance R1 and grounded impedance jωL. The first-stage output then passes through the series R2 and capacitor C to connect to the inverting terminal of the second-stage op-amp; the non-inverting terminal of the second-stage op-amp is grounded, and the feedback resistor R3 is connected back from the output Vout to the inverting terminal, so the second stage is an inverting amplification structure, with input impedance R2 + 1/(jωC). Reasoning calculation: Vin = cos(10^6 t), so the angular frequency ω = 10^6 rad/s. The first-stage gain A1 = 1 + R1/(jωL). The second-stage gain A2 = -R3/(R2 + 1/(jωC)). Substituting R1 = R2 = R3 = 1Ω, L = 1 μH, C = 1 μF: jωL = j·10^6·10^-6 = j, and 1/(jωC) = 1/(j·10^6·10^-6) = 1/j = -j. Therefore A1 = 1 + 1/j = 1 - j; A2 = -1/(1 - j). The total gain is A = A1 A2 = (1 - j)·[-1/(1 - j)] = -1.

method.method_draft: Let the first op-amp output be V1. Because the first + input is Vin, the first − input is also Vin. KCL at that node gives (Vin - V1)/R1 + Vin/(jωL) = 0, so V1/Vin = 1 + R1/(jωL). For the second op-amp, the + input is grounded, so its − input is a virtual ground. The input impedance from V1 to this node is R2 + 1/(jωC). KCL at the second inverting node gives (0 - V1)/(R2 + 1/(jωC)) + (0 - Vout)/R3 = 0, so Vout/V1 = -R3/(R2 + 1/(jωC)). Insert ω = 10^6, R1 = R2 = R3 = 1Ω, L = 1 μH, C = 1 μF, giving jωL = j and 1/(jωC) = -j. Combine the two node-derived ratios to get Vout/Vin = -1.

(0 - V1)/(R2 + 1/(jωC)) + (0 - Vout)/R3 = 0。
所以 Vout/V1 = -R3/(R2 + 1/(jωC))。
已知 Vin = cos(10^6 t)，故 ω = 10^6 rad/s。代入 R1 = R2 = R3 = 1Ω，L = 1 μH，C = 1 μF，有 jωL = j，1/(jωC) = -j。
因此 V1/Vin = 1 + 1/j = 1 - j；第二级增益 Vout/V1 = -1/(1 - j)。
总增益为 (Vout/Vin) = (1 - j)·[-1/(1 - j)] = -1。
